name: yurapita
description: ゆらしてピタッ / Swing & Stick
//: admin:purge runs one SQL statement against the production D1 (see GAME_DESIGN.md §7.11).
Steps: (1) find the row:   npm run admin:purge -- "SELECT board,pidh,t120,created FROM runs WHERE pidh='<pidh>'"
(2) delete the run: npm run admin:purge -- "DELETE FROM runs WHERE board='<key>' AND pidh='<pidh>'"
(3) drop it from the cached top list and bump ver (optimistic lock):
npm run admin:purge -- "UPDATE boards SET top=(SELECT json_group_array(json(value)) FROM json_each(boards.top) WHERE json_extract(value,'$[0]')<>'<pidh>'), ver=ver+1 WHERE board='<key>'"

(4) if the purged run was rank 1, refresh wr: npm run admin:purge -- "UPDATE boards SET wr=(SELECT replay FROM runs WHERE board='<key>' AND t120 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t120, created LIMIT 1), ver=ver+1 WHERE board='<key>'"
(5) take the purged player out of the level histogram (the next hourly rebuild drops them):
npm run admin:purge -- "UPDATE plays SET t120=NULL WHERE board='<key>' AND pidh='<pidh>'"

scripts.deploy: node tools/check-epoch.mjs && npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.test: vitest run --project sim --project data --project core --project input --project store --project ui --project worker
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:test && npm run build:single && playwright test
scripts.ghosts: cd .. && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 uv run python game/tools/ai_ghosts.py
scripts.daily: cd .. && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 uv run python game/tools/daily_pool.py
scripts.fixtures: cd .. && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 uv run python game/tools/export_fixtures.py
scripts.admin:purge: : 'Runs ONE SQL statement on the REMOTE yurapita D1. Usage and steps are in the "//" field of package.json. Example: npm run admin:purge -- "DELETE FROM runs WHERE board=... AND pidh=..."' && wrangler d1 execute yurapita --remote --command
